core_idea: Heishou Pack - Wei Branch Don Quixote is a Status Specialist — **Rupture** focus. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Rupture + Sinking) (max +2). **Heishou Pack** — in Chain Battles, fill backup deployment slots with other Sinners so substitutes enter when a deployed unit **dies** or **Retreats**.
playstyle_guide:
- Chain Battles only — each Sinner equips **one identity**; **death** or **Retreat** Substitutes a backup Sinner in with a fresh rotation. Stagger does not.
- Another **Heishou Pack** identity on a backup **Sinner** is ideal — faction passives and **The Lord of Hongyuan** procs stack across the substitute queue.
- Skills check **2+ Rupture** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Rupture + Sinking) (max +2).
- S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you.

**S1 — Breakthrough** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low / Slightly High stacked).
- If target has Shattermark, deal +25% damage ; Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Rupture + Sinking) on target (max 2)
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Rupture + Sinking)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- If target has Shattermark, deal +25% damage; Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Rupture + Sinking) on target (max 2)
- Inflict +1 Rupture Count; [On Hit] Inflict +1 Sinking Count

**S2 — Seize the Momentum, Shatter the Wall** (BP 4, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Rupture + Sinking) on target (max 2) ; [Combat Start] If this unit has Burgeoning of Horns — 發角 —, convert the last Coin of this Skill into Unbreakable Coin; the last Coin deals +5% damage for every Burgeoning of Horns — 發角 — Stack on this unit (max 15%)
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Rupture + Sinking)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition

**S3 — Crushing Horns ['''破碎角''']** (BP 4, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low / Slightly High stacked).
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Rupture + Sinking) on target (max 2) ; [Combat Start] If this unit has Burgeoning of Horns — 發角 —, convert all Coins of this Skill into Unbreakable Coin and deal +10% damage for every Burgeoning of Horns — 發角 — Stack on this unit (max 30%) ; [On Use] Gain 3 Burgeoning of Horns — 發角 —
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Rupture + Sinking)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
- Inflict +1 Rupture Count; [On Hit] Inflict +1 Sinking Count

Combat passive — **Lament of the Lost Sheep ['''亡羊之嘆''']**: When activating Exalted Command, The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu gains the following effect as the Heishou Bolus Contamination — 黑獸丸染 — effect:.
  - Inflict 1 Sinking upon inflicting Rupture Potency or Count by using a Skill (3 times per turn).
  - On the turn this unit Substituted or Returned to the field, gain 3 Burgeoning of Horns — 發角 —.

Combat passive — **Explosive Battering Ram**: Deal (-Target's SP / 3)% more damage against targets at less than 0 SP (max 15%, rounded down).
  - Deal +1% damage for every 2 (Rupture + Sinking) on target (max 15%).
  - Double this effect and max value against Non-SP targets.

Defense skill — **Counter: I shall crush all that standeth in our way!**: [Clashable Counter].
  - Final Power +1 for every 3 (Rupture + Sinking) on target (max 3).
  - [On Use] Gain 3 Burgeoning of Horns — 發角 — next turn.
